extracted text: The aeronautic aluminum alloy used in this study was the heat treated 4-mm-thick 2024-T351 aluminum alloy. Its nominal chemical composition (by weight%) is Al-6.20Cu3.38Mg-0.55Mn. From Fig. 8, it is possible to identify a hardness level in the nugget, the value of which is lower than that of the base material (163HV0.5).
